name: Accutech Packaging
old_description: Accutech specializes in providing tailored packaging solutions for a variety of industries, including mail order fulfillment, food processing and general manufacturing. As the North American representative of Beck Packautomaten, Accutech offers durable and versatile machines designed for high-output industrial use.
about:
Accutech Packaging operates from Foxborough, Massachusetts, where it serves as the North American representative for Beck Packautomaten, a German builder of high‑output packaging machinery. The company was established to provide tailored packaging solutions for mail‑order fulfillment, food processing, and general manufacturing, though its exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and manufactures custom packaging systems and equipment, and integrates third‑party machines such as Combi case packers, 3M case sealers, ID Technologies label applicators, and Sealed Air protective packaging systems into complete lines. It also stocks and delivers a full range of packaging materials from its warehouse using a dedicated fleet, and offers machinery service, technical support, and parts sales for brands including Markem‑Imaje.

Accutech’s customer base spans electronics, e‑commerce and retail, food manufacturing, and pharmaceutical and life sciences, with additional focus on food and medical packaging applications. Its team brings decades of experience across every segment of the packaging industry.

The company emphasizes a no‑cost consulting service, a team‑based approach that matches the right expert to each account, and a commitment to continuous improvement through quality management system compliance.
